Markus,

We're closing out a compliance inquiry related to the Mercury pilot (tenant id: merc-031). The external auditor has requested demonstrable evidence that the tenant dataset was fully removed from the private VPC we contracted for (on-prem footprint in our LA colo). Specifically they want:
